name: Cruoris FR4

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accelerated Coils
perks.desc:
Speeds up charge.
  •  Faster charge time
  •  Decreases impact damage

perks.name: Enhanced Battery
perks.desc:
Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Ionized Battery
perks.desc:
Large heavy battery.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.desc:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.desc: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Barrel Constrictor
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon reduce its projectile spread for a short duration.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.desc: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
perks.desc: This weapon has increased reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 136 from 1 April 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6I828LxsIqdth4iIlSYRmG?si=8022df8ede664223) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing tougher adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a double special loadout. Cruoris FR4 is a rare Aggressive Frame fusion rifle that shoots three horizontal bursts of four bolts in a widening spread - think of how the Bastion exotic works. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are decent - standard 667ms charge time, 37 Range equates to 21.09m ADS and 16.22m hipfire before damage dropoff, 36 Stability is ×1.11.80 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 34 Handling is 0.45s ready, 0.35s ADS and 0.35s stow speed, 31 Reload Speed is a 2.27s reload, Recoil Direction is 55, Zoom is 15, and magazine size is 6 (max 8). With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 17/20/23/24 (max 25). Handling is the stat that needs the most TLC, so that's the top choice for the barrel perks. As the battery perk, boost the battery size or use Accelerated Coils to reduce charge time. If you're running double special then, after a kill with another weapon, Discord in the first trait perk column gives you 7s of free ammo on a kill as well as reducing both ADS animation and accuracy cone size to ×0.75. Pair that with One For All in the second column for a ×1.3 damage boost for hitting three enemies, and you can cook anything within 15m or so. If you're interested, Cruoris is the genitive singular form of the Latin word for blood or blood clot, "cruor". The Omolon Fluid Dynamics is a useful origin trait, boosting stability and reload speed in the top half of a battery (which should be easy with Discord). Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Ionic Traces or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Quite the interesting revival of this long forgotten frame. We have not one, but TWO additions to this archetype introduced way back in Season 12. For those of you who forget time. That was Beyond Light launch on November 10, 2020. Cruoris FR4 is interesting with Discord giving nearly infinite ammo, and Recycled Energy topping off low ability charges. Barrel Constrictor helps the horizontal spread a bit, while One for All works well at clearing groups of enemies with ease." Recommended MW: Charge Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "These frames were never good in PvP. I wouldn't recommend it at all. Kickstart helps give you more damage per shot to secure the kill in 4 bolts instead of 5, but that's still hard with an uncontrollable horizontal spread." Recommended MW: Range or Charge Time.
